description.text: program aims to help non-native speakers improving their Chinese language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing). Students can attend courses of different levels(beginning, intermediate and advanced)depending on their abilities.Related CoursesBasic ChineseBasic Oral CommunicationIntermediate ChineseIntermediate Oral CommunicationIntermediate ReadingAdvanced Spoken ChineseAdvanced ReadingNewspaper ReadingsBasic CompositionHSK TutoringStudy Duration: Sep. 1- Jan. 20 Tuition Fee: CNY 16,000( teaching materials are not included)

duration.text: The Elementary Chinese at Southeast University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Be in good health condition, which accords with the Health Standard for International Students stipulated by the China Education Department; 2. Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits.
